extraits.texte: So loook forward each week to Zoltans collection. This anniversary mix has many of the tracks i have already got in my own iTunes Chill mix that i put together. This is another classic i listen to these podcasts while i for, drive and at home for ambient music simply brilliant.…

I love Zoltan’s mixes as they are mostly instrumentals & not too fast paced or “loud”. I also like the chill out sess half way through, which is super slow- almost meditative. Great for working & studying.
Never fails to refresh my knowledge of the types of music listed, relax very much, fix my mood. Great guaranteed podcast to subscribe to for a fix of the above. THANKS SO MUCH ZOLTAN! 🙏
